visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of four adults sits around an automatic mahjong table in a modern apartment. A woman in a maroon baseball cap and black off-the-shoulder top laughs while looking at her phone. A man in a dark grey shirt next to her is also on his phone. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Close-up shots show individual reactions: a woman in a black tank top looks determined, a man in a grey shirt talks on his phone, and a man with short dark hair gestures towards the table. Ariel enters from a hallway wearing an ochre t-shirt, holding a Red Bull can. (3) Ariel stands by the table, drinks from the can, and points at the group. A close-up of a phone screen reveals a Tetris game interface. (4) The scene shifts to a full-screen promotional graphic with the Red Bull Tetris logo, a QR code, and smartphone mockups showing a leaderboard. (5) Ariel stands against a plain white background, explaining the event with high energy and hand gestures. (6) The group gathers back at the mahjong table, leaning in towards the camera with shocked and then excited expressions. (7) A final segment styled as a camera viewfinder shows the five friends squeezed onto a brown leather sofa, shouting and playing together on their phones.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo, upbeat electronic BGM kicks in with a bright synthesizer melody. A female voice speaks in a fast, playful, and high-pitched tone, followed by melodic laughter. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the dialogue shifts between characters. A male voice speaks with a slightly lower pitch but high intensity. (3) The distinct sound of a carbonated drink can opening ('pssh') and a short liquid gulp is audible. Ariel's narration begins, maintaining a clear, professional, yet enthusiastic cadence over the steady BGM beat. (4) Frequent digital 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects accentuate the presentation of game features. (5) A sudden collective exclamation ('What!?') from multiple voices creates a peak in volume and arousal. (6) The final phase features layered chatter, rhythmic shouting ('Hold it!'), and loud cheering, creating a chaotic and energetic social atmosphere with high audio event density.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Conflict -> Revelation -> Information -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the 'Red Bull Tetris' event and competition by showcasing a humorous scenario where friends are addicted to the mobile game while appearing to play mahjong, followed by a clear call-to-action for viewers to participate.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product placement of Red Bull cans, explicit promotion of the Red Bull Tetris competition, and a QR code CTA.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses a popular social activity (mahjong) as a subverted hook to introduce a mobile gaming competition. The fast-paced editing and high-arousal audio maintain viewer engagement throughout the promotional segment.
